notes.title: 🩸 Under The Floor – Patch Notes 0.2.75 🩸
notes.content:
Get ready to shiver… This update introduces new paranormal events, gameplay improvements, and numerous fixes to make the horror experience even more intense.
🔔 New Features & Enhancements
Haunting statue: it now emits a sound whenever it moves—keep your eyes open and your ears sharper.

Dynamic footsteps: footstep sounds now change when the player walks on concrete for deeper immersion.

Brighter atmosphere: overall brightness has been slightly increased while maintaining the oppressive mood.

Look further down: the player can now tilt the camera lower to inspect every dark corner.

Two new paranormal events: unexpected supernatural occurrences will keep you on edge.
⚠️ Gameplay Adjustments
Unpredictable hunts: both the waiting time and the duration of hunts are now randomized.

Limited interactions: equipment can no longer be used while interacting with an in-game object.

Improved flashlight: it now recharges faster during the day.

Enhanced Ouija board: completely reworked to better understand the player’s questions.
🕯️ Additional Content
A new warning message now informs players that sleeping will no longer be possible after a certain day…

New objective: complete a special task to obtain the Whispering Key, which unlocks the mysterious basement door.
🛠️ Fixes
Lamps during hunts: fixed an issue where some lamps remained on during a hunt.

Exterior environment clipping: resolved a clipping issue in outdoor scenery.

Ending scene audio: fixed a sound issue during the final scene.

Translation errors: several translation mistakes have been corrected.

Death scene audio: fixed an audio bug in the death scene.

…and many more secrets waiting to be discovered 👀

notes.title: Patch Notes – Version 0.2.73.4
notes.content:
✨ Improvements
Damage visuals: Improved hit and damage effects for better readability.

UI:

Battery display and battery recharge status are now smoother.

Stamina display is now more fluid for a more natural feel.

Added a floating icon for letters to make them easier to spot.

Gameplay: Increased the base repair speed for cameras, making the action faster and more dynamic.
🐞 Fixes
Twitch integration: Fixed an issue where Twitch commands could randomly stop working.

Steam achievements: Achievements already unlocked will no longer attempt to unlock again.

Report menu: Fixed an incorrect translation.

Alarm system: It is no longer possible to enter an infinite number of digits on the keypad.
🔧 Support tools
When sending a report, the player's logs are now automatically attached to help with debugging and future fixes.

notes.title: Under The Floor – Patch Notes v0.2.73
notes.content:
📝 Patch Notes – Version 0.2.73✨ New Features
Cameras can now break and be repaired, adding a new strategic layer to surveillance.

Orbs are visible on cameras, allowing you to track the entity’s position.

New AI spawn method: the entity now spawns on the orbs, making it completely unpredictable.
🌐 Languages
Pre-integration of Italian and Spanish, coming soon in the language options.
🛠 Fixes & Improvements
Fixed various bugs.

Improved overall stability.

Fixed Steam integration: achievements now unlock correctly again.

notes.title: Under The Floor – Patch Notes v0.2.72
notes.content:
✨ New Features
German Language Support: The game is now available in German, selectable in the language options.

Leaderboard: Check out your performance and compare with others through the Stats button in the main menu.

Bug Report System: You can now report issues directly from the main menu or the pause menu.
🎵 Changes
New menu music to freshen up the game’s atmosphere.
🛠 Fixes & Improvements
Fixed several LOD (Level of Detail) issues.

Various minor bug fixes.

General stability improvements.
